help.title: Help
help.description: Quick answers about Oriole and its integrations.
help.needMoreDesc: Full architecture & deployment docs live in this repo. Start with docs/architecture.md.
help.faq1q: How do I create a booking?
help.faq1a: Open the Bookings menu and click “New booking”. The form covers schedule, customer, and AI call options — this feature is live after the bootstrap phase.
help.faq2a: Auth is handled by Neon Auth (managed Better Auth). Sessions are JWTs verified by the backend via remote JWKS — no passwords are stored in this app.
help.faq3a: AI agents place outbound calls to customers for booking confirmations/reminders automatically. Inbound call handling isn't supported yet — call results come back via authenticated webhooks, recorded with idempotency, then queued for processing.
help.faq4a: Paddle acts as the Merchant of Record. Subscription status is synced via HMAC-verified webhooks to an Inngest function.
help.faq5q: When will production feature pages ship?
help.faq5a: This app shell is the foundation. Production dashboard, booking, billing, and analytics are being built on the connected plumbing (DB, auth, billing, jobs, email).

landing.heroHeadline: Turn customer conversations into confirmed bookings.
landing.heroSubheadline: Oriole answers customer questions, captures booking details, follows up, and confirms appointments across WhatsApp, Telegram, calls, and forms — automatically 24/7.
landing.heroTrustBadge: No credit card required · Setup in minutes · Works with your existing channels
landing.integrationTitle: Meet customers where they already are.
landing.integrationDesc: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Google Calendar, Forms, Email, and Payments — connected to one unified booking workflow without changing how you work.
landing.integrationFootnote: From WhatsApp and Telegram conversations to forms, calendars, payments, and webhooks — Oriole keeps the whole booking journey moving.
landing.integrationConnectedDesc: {{count}} of {{total}} integrations connected — your business is ready to go.
landing.problemStatement: Every missed conversation is a lost booking: slow replies, after-hours inquiries, and manual scheduling friction quietly turn demand into empty slots. You're left juggling messages just to keep your calendar full, while high-intent customers move on to the next option.
landing.painTitle: Every missed conversation is a lost booking.
landing.painDesc: Customers don't wait. Slow replies, missed calls, and manual follow-ups quietly turn demand into lost appointments.
landing.painSupportDesc: Customers expect instant answers. While your team is busy with in-person clients, online inquiries go unanswered.
landing.painAnswersDesc: High-intent booking questions arrive late at night or on weekends when nobody is around to respond.
landing.painResponseDesc: Back-and-forth chat messages to find a suitable time create friction and lead to double-booking mistakes.
landing.painVisibilityDesc: Without automated reminders and phone confirmation, booked customers forget to show up.
landing.painMissedDesc: Customers expect instant replies. Slow responses lead them elsewhere.
landing.painSchedulingDesc: Managing bookings through chats and spreadsheets creates unnecessary work.
landing.painRepeatDesc: Your team answers the same questions every day.

landing.whoTitle: Built for businesses that run on appointments.
landing.whoDesc: Whether you run a clinic, salon, studio, or consultancy, Oriole automates the routine so you can focus on delivering great service.
landing.whoBeautyDesc: Salons, spas, barbershops, and nail studios
landing.whoHealthDesc: Dental, physio, medical consults, and therapy
landing.whoLocalDesc: Auto detailing, pet grooming, and studio rentals
landing.solBarbershopDesc: Automate chair bookings, stylist selection, and send instant WhatsApp confirmations.
landing.solNailSalonDesc: Manage nail art slots, technician schedules, and reduce cancellations with reminder calls.
landing.solMassageSpaDesc: Smooth room and therapist scheduling with automated 24/7 reservation handling.
landing.solPetGroomingDesc: Book grooming sessions, capture pet details, and confirm pickup times effortlessly.
landing.solCarDetailingDesc: Organize vehicle drop-offs, service packages, and automatic status notifications.
landing.solYogaPilatesDesc: Fill studio class mats, handle waitlists, and sync attendee counts directly with calendar.
landing.solPersonalTrainerDesc: Schedule 1-on-1 fitness sessions, coordinate client workouts, and prevent missed slots.
landing.solPhotographyStudioDesc: Book studio sessions, photographers, and equipment slots without email back-and-forth.
landing.trustDesc: Built to ensure every customer interaction is answered accurately and on time.
landing.trustStat1Desc: Zero missed inquiries, even outside regular business hours.
landing.trustStat2Desc: Real outbound phone verification to drastically cut no-shows.
landing.trustStat3Desc: Real-time sync with Google Calendar preventing all double-bookings.
landing.trustStat4Desc: Workspace isolation and HMAC-verified webhook integrations.
landing.faqDesc: Quick answers about how Oriole automates your booking and customer workflows.
landing.faq1Q: How does conversational AI booking work?
landing.faq1A: Oriole AI understands natural language messages from customers, checks real-time slot availability from your catalog and staff schedules, asks for necessary details, and completes the booking instantly.
landing.faq2Q: Can I connect my existing WhatsApp and Telegram numbers?
landing.faq2A: Yes! You can connect your official business WhatsApp or Telegram bot in one click. Customers message you as they normally would, and Oriole manages the booking logic seamlessly.
landing.faq3Q: Does Oriole keep my Google Calendar in sync?
landing.faq3A: Absolutely. Oriole reads busy slots to prevent double bookings and immediately writes newly confirmed appointments directly to your Google Calendar.
landing.faq4Q: How do automated AI phone confirmation calls work?
landing.faq4A: When an appointment is scheduled or upcoming, Oriole can place a spoken outbound call to the customer to re-confirm attendance or help them reschedule, ensuring your schedule stays full.
landing.faq5Q: What happens if a customer asks something the AI cannot answer?
landing.faq5A: You maintain full control at all times. When a message requires human nuance, it is clearly flagged in your unified inbox, allowing your team to jump in and reply manually anytime.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Stop losing bookings to slow follow-ups.
landing.finalCtaDesc: Start answering customers, filling your calendar, and confirming appointments automatically in minutes.
landing.finalCtaSubtext: Free to start · Instant setup · No credit card required
landing.footerTagline: AI customer-to-booking engine for service businesses.
landing.footerDescription: Oriole turns customer conversations into confirmed bookings across WhatsApp, Telegram, calls, and web forms.

legal.userAgreementSubtitle: Terms of service and user obligations for using the Oriole platform.
legal.privacyPolicySubtitle: How Oriole collects, protects, uses, and respects your personal and customer data.
legal.uaSection1Text: By creating an account, signing in, or accessing any service provided by Oriole, you agree to be bound by this User Agreement, our Privacy Policy, and any applicable operating rules. If you do not agree to these terms, you must not use our services.
legal.uaSection2Text: Oriole provides automated appointment booking, customer relationship management (CRM), AI-powered voice calling, multi-channel inbox integration (WhatsApp, Telegram, Meta, LINE), and analytics for businesses and teams.
legal.uaSection3Text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must immediately notify Oriole of any unauthorized use or security breach. You agree to provide accurate and complete information during registration.
legal.uaSection4Text: You agree not to use Oriole for any unlawful purposes, unsolicited spam calls or messages, abusive activities, harassment, or actions that violate telecommunication and privacy regulations. Oriole reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts violating these rules.
legal.uaSection5Text: Paid plans and usage quotas are billed according to your selected subscription tier through authorized payment processors (Paddle). Cancellations, upgrades, and renewals are governed by our billing terms.
legal.uaSection6Text: Oriole is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. Oriole shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of or inability to use the service.
legal.uaSection7Text: Oriole may update this Agreement from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or through the application. Continued use of our service after changes constitutes acceptance.
legal.ppSection1Text: We collect account information (name, email), workspace and staff data, customer booking details (names, phone numbers, scheduled times), communication logs (inbox messages, call records), and technical telemetry.
legal.ppSection2Text: Your data is used to provide booking and CRM services, initiate AI call reminders and messaging, process transactions, prevent bot abuse and fraud, and continuously improve platform stability.
legal.ppSection3Text: We employ industry-standard security protocols. Sensitive communication messages are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with workspace-derived keys. Network traffic is encrypted via TLS/HTTPS.
legal.ppSection4Text: We integrate with trusted providers including Cloudflare (bot detection and Turnstile security), Paddle (payment processing), Vapi & Telnyx (voice AI infrastructure), and Meta & Telegram (messaging channels).
legal.ppSection5Text: You have the right to access, update, export, or delete your personal data. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting our support team.
legal.ppSection6Text: We use necessary security cookies and Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA-free bot verification on authentication pages to safeguard accounts against unauthorized automated attacks.
legal.ppSection7Text: If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact our privacy team at privacy@oriole.com.
